introduction: Vermont UI replaces part of lost wages after qualifying unemployment. The Department of Labor now uses an updated claimant system.
description: Vermont UI replaces part of lost wages after qualifying unemployment. The Department of Labor now uses an updated claimant system.

sections.who: The state reviews wage history, separation and continuing eligibility. Use current claimant instructions rather than an older portal address.
sections.get: Eligible weekly payments provide temporary support. Initial and weekly claims are distinct submissions.
sections.docs:
• Identity and contact details.
  • Employer, work-date and wage records.
  • The separation reason and any requested evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Establish the claim

    Use Claimant e-Services or call initial intake at 877-214-3330.

  2. Follow verification

    Complete identity and information requests.

  3. File weekly

    Use claimant e-Services or the automated weekly-claim number 800-983-2300 during its posted filing hours.
sections.after: Claimant assistance is 877-214-3332. Read decisions and report earnings accurately in each requested week.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Current state UI system instructions. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is the employer portal for my claim?
No. Use the Claimant e-Services portal.
Are initial and weekly phone numbers the same?
No. The state lists separate numbers.
Can I reopen a prior claim online?
The updated claimant system supports reopening.
Does filing once cover later weeks?
No. File weekly claims as instructed.
